zh: 新增「沉浸式浏览」：滑动时自动收起顶栏与底栏（外观设置开启，默认关闭）
新增 6 款应用图标配色，可随时更换
每日 Daily Picks 提醒到点推送更准时（设置中开启，默认关闭）
en: New "Immersive browsing": bars tuck away as you scroll (enable in Appearance, off by default)
6 new app icon colorways to pick from
Daily Picks reminders now arrive on time (enable in Settings, off by default)
